blocks.title: Enable Apps and deployments for {organization}
blocks.purpose: Lists the apps you build and deploy in Ever Works on your organization's account pages, and on your public profile if you choose. Only identifiers and status move. App content, repositories, budgets, agents and memory never leave Ever Works.
